kitesurf.where: Browser Run CDP ?browser=kitesurf (UA Kitesurf/0.0.1); keep_alive is refused
kitesurf.localhost_note: loads its own localhost, not the container's
kitesurf.cost: free in beta, per-account limits; stateless, no long sessions

why: Only the in-container browser sees the thread's own dev servers, keeps cookies across a session, and needs no extra bill. Its frame rate and input latency match or beat Browser Run. Kitesurf stays a later option for fast stateless agent reads of public pages.
